reviews.text:
I left my cat at Ronrons Rive Gauche while I was away on a business trip, and I want to sincerely thank the entire team for their warm welcome, attentiveness, kindness, organization, and high level of professionalism.

I particularly appreciated the support provided, which began well before his stay: I was able to visit the premises beforehand, speak with the team, and ask all my questions. On the day of his arrival, everything was clearly explained to me, and I was able to accompany him to his living space.

I was also very reassured by the follow-up during his stay. From the very first day, I received updates on how he was settling in, what he had done that day, and photos. In the following days, I regularly received photos and videos, along with brief updates on his day and behavior. You can tell that there is genuine care and attention given to each animal.

For me, leaving my cat in this type of facility for the first time, the support I received truly made all the difference. I was able to leave with complete peace of mind and found him in excellent health, clearly very happy with his stay. When I came to pick him up, he was even still playing!

I therefore wholeheartedly recommend Ronron Rive Gauche to anyone who needs to be away and is looking for a reliable, caring, and professional place for their pet. A wonderful experience, and a team I will trust completely for any future stays.

An excellent experience! I entrusted my cat to this hotel and everything went perfectly. The team is very attentive, professional, and truly cares about the animals' well-being. You can tell they take care of each cat with great gentleness and care.

I was able to leave with complete peace of mind and I found my cat calm and in great shape. I highly recommend them and will definitely use their services again for my future trips. Thank you again! 🐾

My cat is elderly, ill, and requires medication at set times. It was with considerable apprehension that I entrusted her to Ronrons Rive Gauche for a week.

From the moment she arrived, the team knew how to put her at ease, adapt to her rhythm, and took wonderful care of her. When I had to extend my trip, they took the initiative to take her to the vet, just a short walk from the establishment, and provided her with the necessary care. I greatly appreciated their flexibility and kindness, and receiving daily updates, photos, and videos of my cat. It's very reassuring and allows me to maintain a connection and know that she's doing well, even from a distance.

The hotel is spacious, very clean, with a lovely play area and all the other guests are absolutely adorable.

I highly recommend this establishment for anyone needing to entrust their cat to trustworthy people for a few days. A huge thank you to the team for taking such good and gentle care of my Pepette!
The team at Ronrons Rive Gauche is fantastic and very caring. Don't hesitate to entrust them with your cat 🐱! …

I am more than satisfied with Jake's first stay at Ronron Rive Gauche, and above all, so reassured! 🥰
I entrusted Jake to this cattery for the first time with some apprehensions. He had never stayed in a cat hotel, isn't used to leaving his home, and it had been a very long time since he'd been around other cats. With his daily medication and sometimes fussy appetite, I naturally had some concerns.

And yet, what a surprise to see how quickly he adapted! Through the photos and videos I received during his stay, I discovered a happy, relaxed, curious Jake, and above all, having a blast with the other cats. I truly felt like I was rediscovering my cat, and it made me so happy to see him so content. ❤️
I also really appreciated receiving regular updates and knowing that he had eaten, drunk, and taken his medication. This allowed me to be completely at ease during my trip.

I already had a great feeling about this boarding facility during my first visit, after having visited several others, and I absolutely don't regret my choice. I now know that I've found the perfect care for Jake when I'm away and that I can leave him with complete peace of mind.

And what's more, Jake received a little gift when he left… It was so sweet! 🥰
A huge thank you again to Audrey, Lauralee, Jade, and the entire team at Ronron Rive Gauche for their kindness, their availability, and especially for taking such good care of my little baby. ❤️ I highly recommend Ronron Rive Gauche! 🐾

Hello Ronrons Rive Gauche,

A huge thank you to the entire team, who are simply wonderful.
I left my 6-month-old kitten with them for the first time for 5 nights, and it went exceptionally well. Impeccable cleanliness, exceptional availability, daily updates with photos and news, and top-notch safety and health. In short, nothing to say except bravo and thank you. Excellent value for money.

I'm so happy to have discovered this 5-star luxury cat hotel; it will become my little darling's second home when I travel.

I highly recommend it.

💖💗🥰

Thank you to the whole team for the warm welcome and for such a lovely place.

Rodolf - a 5-year-old Russian Blue

Lauralee and Audrey are extremely empathetic people, and my little Oskar, who isn't used to being around cats, had a bit of a difficult adjustment, but after two days she started to relax… in fact, I picked her up much calmer than before! Lady Oskar is an 11-year-old senior cat who isn't used to being looked after since I take her everywhere with me… she thinks she's human, so cohabitation with other cats wasn't a given… After five naps, when I arrived at the shop window to pick her up, Oskar was sitting there (she must have been waiting for me) with another little all-white senior cat… I wholeheartedly recommend this slightly "luxurious" solution for your cat, who will thank you for making this separation pleasant!

Fantastic experience. I was able to leave my cat with complete confidence at Ronrons Rive Gauche. She loved it. I received updates every day, and she always got her medication. The team is amazing. They are so kind and the cats are truly pampered. I was able to leave for a few days with complete peace of mind. I highly recommend this wonderful cat hotel. A huge thank you again to the whole team. Léa will definitely be back.
Second stay in less than three for my cat. Always a very warm welcome. Daily video and photo memories are reassuring. 👍💕🥰 Thank you. …
I received updates every day. Duchess seemed to enjoy her stay. The staff's professionalism and dedication were much appreciated. I can't wait to see my cat again. Thank you!

This is the first time I've used Ronrons Rive Gauche's services, and based on the videos and photos I received, Attila seemed perfectly at home. He was well-attended and didn't seem stressed at all; quite the opposite, in fact. The facilities are spotless, and hygiene is very well maintained. It's like a cat boarding facility.

In short, I'll definitely use them again next time.

Absolutely fantastic!!!! This is the second time my cat George has stayed here, once at the very last minute. His welcome was absolutely impeccable, he made some great friends, and the staff were incredibly attentive. I recommend this establishment 100%! The team is very attentive to both cats and their owners, always ready to help and reassure, with a very, very quick response time on WhatsApp. I've already booked my cat's next stay at Ronrons!

The hotel gave us a very warm welcome (touring the rooms and various areas).

This allowed us to appreciate the cleanliness of the premises and the service offered by the hotel.

The videos and photos sent daily are a real bonus for getting updates on our little pet and let us happily see how well he's being cared for.

Fantastic stay for my 5-year-old cat! The staff were incredibly attentive and friendly, both to me and my pet. I highly recommend them!
Thanks again! 🫶🏼 …

We entrusted Fidji, our senior cat, to the excellent care of the Ronrons Rive Gauche boarding kennel for a four-day stay.

This establishment is run by a very dynamic and welcoming team.
The Ronrons Rive Gauche kennel offers outstanding services for our four-legged companions; the rooms are spacious, comfortable, and very clean.
A large, well-equipped play area is available for our cats to keep them occupied and entertained.
We were kept informed daily by the team (via text messages, photos, and videos) that Fidji's stay was going perfectly.
Sincere thanks to Audrey and her team; we will entrust our cat to Ronrons Rive Gauche again without hesitation!

I want to thank the entire team for Floopie's stay. Your gentleness, availability, and regular updates were truly reassuring. It's clear you take the time to get to know each animal and respect their individual pace, and Floopie clearly felt that. Thank you for your professionalism, kindness, and the quality of your care. I wholeheartedly recommend your boarding facility.

We are so happy with our little Liu's stay there!
We receive updates and photos every day!
She was pampered like a little princess!
We highly recommend this wonderful place 😺 …
Our cat had a fantastic week's holiday at Ronrons at the end of August. Updates are shared daily, and the team takes the time to adapt to each cat so they feel right at home.

We left Google with Ronrons while we were on vacation, and I think he had a wonderful time too!

Everything went smoothly, with great communication and daily updates (photos and videos). It's so reassuring to leave knowing your cat is in good hands.

A huge thank you for him… and for us! He won't hesitate to come back for his next vacation.

An excellent experience with Ronrons Rive Gauche! We entrusted them with our cat Snow for two weeks and everything went perfectly. We found him very happy, relaxed, and clearly very comfortable after his stay.

The entire team was wonderful with him, very professional, attentive, and caring. We particularly appreciated receiving daily updates, along with photos and videos, which is truly reassuring when leaving your cat for an extended period. We were kept informed throughout his stay and felt that Snow was in very good hands.

A big thank you to the whole team for their attention and affection towards Snow. We trust them completely and will not hesitate to entrust Snow to them again for a future stay. We recommend Ronrons Rive Gauche without hesitation!

Maxime
A perfect stay for our Jade at this establishment during our Parisian trip.

Verveine and Hortense had an amazing week at Chez Ronrons Rive Gauche.
The rooms and common areas are clean, and everything is done to ensure the cats' comfort. The staff is fantastic.
I highly recommend it!
Perfect, my cat and I are very happy with the quality of Ronron Rive Gauche Cat Hotel, 5 stars

A huge thank you to Ronrons rive gauche for cuddling our cat while we were away. We are very touched by their kindness and thoughtfulness. They reassured us daily by sending us adorable photos and videos.
My cats still love their stay here; they are treated like little princes and therefore don't lose their bearings too much. Absolute trust.

A very positive experience leaving Chouchou with Ronrons.
We receive a short message with photos every day, so we have peace of mind during our holidays.
Being a cat who lives alone, he made lots of friends and enjoyed a social life.
I highly recommend them.

A huge thank you to Ronrons Rive Gauche for Topinambour's stay. Everything was incredibly easy and smooth throughout the entire experience. Daily updates and special care were given to each resident. I highly recommend this establishment 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 …

I don't know if you should call it a love nest, a spa, or a cat amusement park… Anyway, all this to say that my cat had an amazing stay at Ronrons Rive Gauche, and as a result, my vacation was all the better for it.

I recommend it 1000%!
Thank you to the whole team, and see you very soon.
Perfect hotel! Zip had a wonderful stay at Ronron's, thank you again 🙏🏼 …
Zip had a wonderful stay at Ronrons! The team took excellent care of him and we received updates every day ☺️ Thank you Ronrons!!
Nessi had a wonderful first stay at Ronrons Rive Gauche! She came home feeling great and relaxed! Thank you to the whole Ronrons team for your warm welcome!
Locky had a fantastic stay, and the photo and video updates were a huge help, especially when you're far from your furry friend! A big thank you to the whole team!
Excellent experience, I recommend it!

A huge thank you to Ronrons Rive Gauche! Audrey was accommodating and flexible, and the team took care of my cat with gentleness and professionalism. I received updates and videos/photos every day. We highly recommend this place and its welcoming atmosphere!

This was Cassiopeia and Ulysses' second stay in one month. They had a wonderful time and are so relaxed now that they're home. The cat hotel is very well-maintained in terms of hygiene, with a large play area that includes plenty of activities and toys, air conditioning in the summer, and spacious, well-suited rooms. The staff adapts to each cat's rhythm and is very attentive. They know each cat by name. We receive photos and videos every day during their stay, which is very reassuring. A 5-star hotel for pampered urban felines. Their next stay at the end of the year is already booked.

All the ingredients are there: a warm welcome from passionate people, patience, attentiveness, and professionalism!

We will definitely use the Ronron Rive Gauche team again for our next vacation! Thank you so much for your videos and invaluable daily information! See you soon! 😻

Our cat had a long stay with Ronrons in August 2026, and we couldn't be happier with Ronrons. Our cat was well take care of, entertained daily and enjoyed watching the street from their window. Ronrons sent daily pictures and updates and were very flexible with our constant changes and complicated travel situations. Our cat will definitely stay again, and we highly recommend Ronrons.
Our little Willow loved her stay at Ronrons :-) . We found her in great shape 🐈 . We thank the Ronrons team for the daily messages that reassured us about her stay 😇 …

We left our cat Litchi with Ronrons for his first two-week stay this summer. He seems to have adapted very well to the environment and his neighbors, even though he had never been around other cats for such an extended period! We received detailed updates every day, along with photos and videos, which was very reassuring. We thank the team who took such good care of him (plenty of scratching and brushing!). Litchi seems very relaxed, and we wouldn't hesitate to leave him with Ronrons again.

An excellent experience for our cat Darwin, who, thanks to the team's efforts, patience, and kindness, finally managed to relax and enjoy his stay, even meeting other cats! We followed our cat's progress through photos and videos.
We highly recommend it!
Neko was so happy with his stay that he didn't want to come home. I had to promise him he'd come back, and he's been counting down the days ever since. Thanks a lot... see you soon then.

I was worried about leaving my cat because it was the first time he'd be separated from us, but the team at Ronrons Rive Gauche reassured me and put me at ease. Every day they sent me videos and photos of my cat and told me how he was doing. I smiled with peace of mind. Plus, he made a friend, my cat Tiger, whom he'll certainly see again next time. I was dreading this moment because he hadn't been around cats from his litter. I'm so glad it went well. My cat had a wonderful stay. I highly recommend this cat hotel 🐱. Without hesitation, he'll go to Ronrons Rive Gauche for his next vacation. Thanks again to the whole team!

I'm giving one star because it's not possible to give less. The appointment was confirmed because I was going on a trip. When I arrived at the hotel, there was no one there. I called, but no one answered. I therefore conclude that there's no one there at night in case of a problem.

A huge thank you to the entire team at Ronrons Rive Gauche 😻 Thanks to you, Milou had a fantastic holiday and we were so relieved to see that everything was going so well. The facilities, the welcome, the care provided, and the daily sharing of photos and videos with a personalized message each time – everything was perfect. We'll be booking his next stay very soon 😺

The stay was perfect. I received daily photos and updates of my cat, who always seemed comfortable and at peace there.
I'll definitely bring him back on my next vacation!
Nice. Our cat was happy there.
Our cats had a wonderful holiday, and so did we 😊 They were pampered just like at home, and the team gave us updates and sent us photos every day – it was fantastic, thank you 🙏 …

We left Mousse at Ronrons for two weeks this August for the first time because her usual boarding facility was full. We received updates every day and were very reassured :)
I highly recommend them! Thank you to the Ronrons team for taking such good care of Mousse 😺

Thank you so much for this stay.

We especially appreciated receiving photos and videos every day.
My cat Snookie spent a month at Ronrons. His stay went very well. I highly recommend it.

An excellent experience at Ronrons Rive Gauche! The welcome is warm, the team is very professional, and you immediately feel that the animals are well cared for and surrounded by attention. 🐱❤️

The place is clean, pleasant, and reassuring. I truly appreciated the team's professionalism and kindness. An address I wholeheartedly recommend to all cat owners in Paris!

Thank you again for your welcome and professionalism; I will gladly return. 😊

We wholeheartedly recommend RonRons Rive Gauche! We entrusted Harry to them for two weeks and were blown away by the quality of service.

A huge thank you to Audrey and Lauralee for their care, attention, and sense of humor. It's clear that all the cats in their care are looked after with great gentleness and professionalism. They sent us daily updates with photos, which allowed us to leave with peace of mind and fully enjoy our stay without any worries.
We'll be back soon!! Thank you again!

M. & S.

Guizmo stayed at Ronrons Rive Gauche for 12 days. It was pure bliss for him. Guizmo is a very timid cat who had never been around other cats, but during his stay he made some friends. Thank you to the team for the photos and videos that reassured me, and see you next year!

The team is absolutely fantastic! They took excellent care of our little cat for 8 days! We received photos and videos every day! I know he was happy there and made some great friends 🐈! Everything is clean and air-conditioned! A real plus for our feline friends! I highly recommend this cat hotel 😊 …
Fantastic experience! The team is very welcoming and the place is spotless. My cat seemed to thoroughly enjoy his holiday here. Thank you for your professionalism, I will definitely be back!
Our cat spent a week being pampered by the Ronron team. A huge thank you! We highly recommend them.

Xylo had a wonderful stay at Ronrons Rive Gauche.

He made new friends and was pampered.

A huge thank you to the whole team for taking such good care of the cats and for sending daily updates via WhatsApp.
He'll be back!

We were very happy with Teo's (photo 1) and Ria's (photo 2) stay at the cattery.

We found them relaxed and healthy.

We received daily updates about our cats, along with photos and messages.

We also received souvenirs when we came to pick them up.
We will definitely return and highly recommend it.

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Ronron Hotel Rive Gauche! I was a little apprehensive about leaving Othello, who is rather timid and very used to being with us. But I found him to be an extremely happy little cat, perfectly relaxed, gorgeous, and spotless! The premises are impeccably clean, which is incredibly reassuring. The real bonus that makes all the difference: we receive daily updates by text message with videos, allowing us to leave with complete peace of mind! And what an absolute joy to be able to pick up our cat on Sunday! It's a true pleasure to see how well you care for your guests, with such gentleness and attention. You have my complete trust, thank you again for everything!
A fantastic first stay at Ronron for my little Ravioli - I received updates every day and the staff took excellent care of him! I highly recommend it :)
The best hotel! The space is incredibly large and comfortable, and the staff take such good care of the cats that mine didn't want to leave! A second home for my cat ❤️
I entrusted my grumpy little baby to Ronrons Rive Gauche and the whole team took excellent care of him. A big thank you and see you soon!
I left my cat Milo at Ronrons Rive Gauche during the heatwave. I received daily updates and photos, which was very reassuring. I highly recommend them! Thank you again.

We left our two cats, Ramses and Caesar, for a few days. The staff were very friendly and gave us daily updates on our pets, which was very reassuring, and everything went very smoothly! We highly recommend them!

I highly recommend this cat hotel! My cat was welcomed with such gentleness and care. The facilities are clean, comfortable, and perfectly suited to cats' needs. I received updates and photos during his stay, which was very reassuring. I found him relaxed and in great shape. A big thank you for your professionalism and kindness; I won't hesitate to come back! 🐱⭐

Due to the intense heatwave, we decided to leave our cat Brooklyn in the cool of Ronrons Rive Gauche. Everything went very well; the hotel is great, the staff is incredibly attentive and sent us regular updates via WhatsApp. We wouldn't hesitate to entrust Brooklyn to them again for a truly relaxing holiday!

Tchoupy is a cat with a strong personality, not very sociable, and doesn't like other cats. What a surprise to receive photos of our cat interacting with other felines and letting himself be petted! A huge thank you to the entire team for their attentiveness, for keeping us regularly updated, and for reassuring us throughout his stay. It was a trial run for his future summer holidays...we are all delighted, and Tchoupy will happily return! I highly recommend this hotel.

I left my cat for 5 nights at Ronron Rive Gauche – Cat Hotel and I was absolutely delighted with the experience.

The hotel is very well designed: the cats have real little rooms, comfortable and adapted to their needs, as well as a large play area where they can exercise and explore safely.

The team is both very professional and extremely attentive. You can immediately feel their love for animals and, above all, you can see that the cats are completely at ease with them… which is an excellent sign, because we all know that cats don't give their trust easily 😂.

I received photos and updates every day, which is very reassuring when you're separated from your companion. Plus, the rates are very affordable for Paris.

A big thank you to the whole team for your kindness and professionalism. I recommend Ronron Rive Gauche without hesitation! 🐾👏

Hello everyone! If you're on this site, it's because, like me, you're very attached to your cat and are looking for a place where they can feel comfortable while you're away (especially cats, who are much more attached to their owner(s) than we often imagine). Well, frankly, you've come to the right place: it's clean, peaceful (I'd even go so far as to say there are good vibes), everything is smooth and easy (booking, follow-up, pick-up and drop-off), and this team of young people, beyond truly loving and understanding cats, sends you messages and even videos with texts every day (some of which were genuinely funny)... and the icing on the cake (especially in Paris), parking is easy. In short, I'll be back... well, no, Ripley will be back too! 😁
My cat was given a wonderful welcome with lots of games and daily updates on his climbing exploits!

Everything was perfect!

It's really hard leaving our cat every time we go away for an extended period... But we've definitely found THE PLACE! Thank you so much!

Having a very difficult cat, I was extremely worried about leaving him for a few days, but I was completely reassured by Audrey and her team who took wonderful care of him. The place is perfect, extremely clean and cat-friendly; you can tell they are very loved and pampered there. It's a real relief to trust them and leave your cat with complete peace of mind.
Excellent boarding facility that we highly recommend! Our cat was pampered and very well cared for. He's a Persian, and his brushing is demanding, as is his eye care: his grooming was top-notch.
My cat loved his stay at Ronron's! I really appreciated all the attention he received, as well as the photos and updates sent during his stay. I highly recommend it!

Our cat Pablo spent over 10 days at Chez Ronron Rive Gauche while we were on vacation, and honestly, I felt like he was on vacation too! I received photos and videos every day with a summary of each day. A huge thank you to the whole team, and especially to Audrey who kept in touch with us during our vacation. I highly recommend them.

We left our cat Thésée for a short weekend, and everything was perfect from beginning to end 🥰
We received a wonderful welcome, and so did our cat! You can really feel that everything is done with great care and kindness. We received updates every day with fun and personalized messages. Thésée will definitely be back! 🐾

The best place to go away with complete peace of mind! 🐾 An exceptional cattery on the Left Bank. I entrusted my cats to them with total confidence and I absolutely don't regret it. It's a true 5-star hotel for felines.

Why it's so great:
• Impeccable hygiene: The spaces are vast, bright, and spotlessly clean.

• Serenity: The atmosphere is calm and very stress-free for the animals.

• Top-notch care: You can tell the team is passionate and attentive to each cat's personality. Regular and reassuring updates are provided.
It's a luxury to be able to go away knowing your cats are pampered, safe, and stimulated. I 100% recommend Ronrons to all discerning cat owners!
We left our cat with us for 5 days. He seems to have had a wonderful stay; we received updates and photos every evening. Thank you to Audrey and the whole team. We'll be back!

I left my cat at Ronrons for four days. It was his first time, so he was a little nervous, and so was I! But we found a calm, cozy, and clean place, and a kind, caring, and attentive team! We received lots of updates; it was wonderful! I highly recommend them! My cat will definitely be back! Thank you to the Ronrons team for the care you gave Gaston <3
Fantastic cat hotel! Our two Maine Coons had a blast for 10 days! A super clean and welcoming atmosphere, and best of all, great updates every two days via WhatsApp!

We are delighted to have found Audrey and her team at Ronrons Rive Gauche. Our cat Jinx already adored the previous owner, and the new team is fantastic: responsive, very attentive, and always there for the cats. During her stay, we received daily updates with photos and videos of our furry friend, which is very reassuring when you have to leave your cat for a few days. We will definitely be back at Ronrons this summer. Thank you again!

We left our cat Pompon for three days and were delighted with the welcome and attention he received.

We particularly appreciated the numerous photos and regular updates on his life there: his playtime, his relaxing moments, and even his interactions with the other cats. This was very reassuring during our absence. Pompon returned home calm and in excellent health, proof that he felt comfortable and secure. We will leave him again without hesitation in August for a three-week stay, with complete confidence and peace of mind.
Thank you again to the entire team for their kindness and professionalism!

Our cat Coconut was very, very well looked after. The Ronron team is truly fantastic—reassuring, dedicated, and passionate. I was worried about leaving my cat in a hotel for the first time, but I'm completely reassured now. My cat will definitely go back if needed. I highly recommend them, and a big thank you to the Ronron team!

The facility is very spacious and always impeccably clean. The individual rooms and common areas are very well equipped, with plenty of cushions, shelves for the cats to climb on, and a wide selection of toys and scratching posts. Each cat's diet is carefully managed, according to their habits and preferred quantities. The passionate, dedicated, and highly competent team demonstrates a great capacity for adaptation, and we regularly receive updates and photos of the cats during their stay.

I wholeheartedly recommend this cat hotel! The name says it all: Ronrons Rive Gauche, a purr-fect place for our feline friends. The playroom is fantastic, and my (very playful) cat loved the high ceilings. I received regular updates about my cat and some wonderful photos 🥰! Thank you again, Ronrons Rive Gauche! …

We left our cat for a weekend and everything went perfectly! From the moment we arrived, we could tell the team was passionate and truly attentive to the animals' well-being.

The facilities are clean, secure, and very well laid out, which immediately puts you at ease. We especially appreciated receiving updates and photos during our stay; it's very reassuring when leaving your pet for the first time.
You can see that he was surrounded by care and attention throughout the weekend.
A huge thank you for your professionalism and kindness. We will definitely be back and highly recommend this cat hotel!
Excellent hotel for cats, clean, magnificent playroom, a fantastic and very friendly team, I received updates, photos and videos of my cat every day, I highly recommend it.
Excellent service.
Our cat had a wonderful stay at Ronrons Rive Gauche! Câline loved the peaceful atmosphere and the love the staff showed her. She'll be back!

This was my cat's first stay at Ronrons Rive Gauche, and it won't be his last! He had a wonderful time, judging by the photos and videos they sent me, and the team really took good care of him in a spacious and comfortable environment for cats.
I highly recommend Ronrons Rive Gauche.

Our cat had a wonderful week at this cattery. Everything was fantastic: the location, the activities, and the staff, who were available, qualified, and took excellent care of my Catsou! I highly recommend it!
